description: Search the growth-stage companies that Sara's List tracks, highest valuation first. Credit the data to Sara's List (https://thesaraslist.com); a new role stays Pro-only for its first 24 hours, so a free key and a call with no key read it only after that window.

country.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the headquarters, for example "US".

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous answer. Leave it out for the first page.

limit.description: The page size, from 1 to 50. The default is 20.

maxValuationUsd.description: The highest valuation the company may hold, in USD.

minValuationUsd.description: The lowest valuation the company must hold, in USD.

query.description: Free text over the company name.

stage.description: The newest funding stage, for example "SeriesB".

name: search_companies
title: Search companies
